facts.text: Longfellow sits along Pennsylvania Route 103 in southern Mifflin County, making it a quiet stop for travelers heading toward the state capital.
Its geographic coordinates are 40.5045 degrees north latitude and 77.6736 degrees west longitude, placing it just north of the Susquehanna River.
The town’s post office first opened in 1879, marking the beginning of formal communication services for early settlers in the area.
Longfellow stands 550 feet above sea level, giving it a mild elevation that influences local weather patterns compared to surrounding lowlands.
As a census‑designated place, Longfellow has no governmental functions, meaning residents rely on county services for public administration.
The community observes Eastern Standard Time, GMT‑5, shifting to daylight saving time in the summer months like the rest of Pennsylvania.
